description: Adds a brand to the shared library by its site (or finds it if it's there) and reads the site for its affiliate or ambassador program: the network or form behind it, an email to apply to, a commission and a follower minimum. robots.txt is respected; a few pages at most. Takes up to half a minute for a new brand. Every creator then sees it in brand_programs_search.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

url.description: The brand's site or program page, e.g. lumenfilm.com

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_program_add
title: Add a brand
